subject.title: fix(sessions): reject altered visible message cursors

question: Should visible-message pagination now reject all byte-distinct rewrites of an OpenClaw-issued continuation cursor, including semantically equivalent padding or added envelope fields?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven, but it deliberately removes permissive continuation behavior that a downstream caller may have relied on; accepting that compatibility boundary is a repository product/API decision.

options.title: Accept strict canonical cursors
options.body: Treat Plugin SDK continuation cursors as opaque byte strings and merge this reset-on-rewrite behavior.

options.title: Preserve tolerant aliases
options.body: Keep accepting equivalent rewritten cursor forms and limit any change to preventing untrusted fields from being re-emitted.

recommendation.title: Accept strict canonical cursors
recommendation.body: Treat Plugin SDK continuation cursors as opaque byte strings and merge this reset-on-rewrite behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete behavior comparison and maintain the paired cursor-hardening context, though a repository owner should make the final compatibility decision.
